description:
Choose which browser opens every link.

LinkUnbound puts itself between a link and your browsers, so every link opens where you
want it. It becomes the default handler for http and https, and when a link arrives it
asks which browser — or answers on its own, from a rule you taught it. Rules remember
the choices you make, by site, by profile or by the program the link came from. Work in
one browser and personal in another, without moving a default back and forth. Everything
stays on your machine: no account, no telemetry, no server.
v2.11.0
Until now the picker always wrote in the same letters at the same size, and a
rule for an application asked you to type its name exactly as the picker
showed it.
- A new Appearance page gathers the text size, the density, high contrast, the
  theme, the picker's look and where it opens. A miniature picker changes with
  each choice, and Preview opens the real one. With large text or on a small
  screen, the picker adjusts to fit.
- Choose any font installed on your computer for the picker and the settings.
  System stays the default, and if you uninstall the font you chose, they go
  back to it.
- High contrast brings bolder text, visible edges and a picker that stays
  opaque over any background. Even without it, the grey text in the settings
  now reads better.
- In Rules, search by address, application or browser, filter by kind and edit
  a rule without it losing its place. If a rule's browser is gone, it says so
  and lets you choose another.
- Test a link to see which browser it would open in, which rule wins and why.
- A rule for an application now lets you pick it from the applications that
  sent you links, with their icons. The list keeps only their names, never the
  links.
- LinkUnbound now starts on Windows computers that lacked a Microsoft
  component it needed.
What's Changed
- build(deps): tauri-build 2.7 puts the sidecar where Rust 1.100 builds, so the Mac checks pass again by @rgdevment in #97
- ci: the Dev Drive is mounted beside the checkout, so the Rust cache on Windows keeps its target by @rgdevment in #96
- fix(deps): cookie, quinn, url, webpki-root-certs, tokio and rustix past their advisories, chrono ignored by @rgdevment in #98
- feat(settings): five text sizes, and grey text that reads 4.5:1 in light and dark by @rgdevment in #101
- fix(picker): the resident carries the VC runtime inside, so it starts on a Windows that never installed it by @rgdevment in #104
- refactor(rules): the Rules screen takes the Settings type scale, caution for broken rules and ink-2 chips by @rgdevment in #105
- feat(fonts): the picker writes in any installed font, System by default, and settings can list them by @rgdevment in #106
- feat(settings): an Appearance page with text size, density and high contrast, and a live picker preview by @rgdevment in #107
- feat(appearance): pick any installed font from a searchable list, worn by the picker and the settings window by @rgdevment in #108
- feat(rules): from-app rules pick the app from a list of those links came from, with counts and icons by @rgdevment in #109
- feat(news): what 2.11.0 brings, and a Mac offers only the fonts the picker can draw by @rgdevment in #110
